messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences in which a source ("according to the filing", "the records say") reports this fact, and the passage presents it as true: Kite Fumada founded Zolu Industries

response: According to the filing, Kite Fumada founded Zolu Industries in its early years as a small studio. The records say the company grew from that first office into a firm with several divisions.
